subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should OpenClaw standardize yielded-parent wake/resume as one cross-runtime lifecycle path, or continue landing narrow ACP/native/blocked-delivery repairs independently?
rationale: The issue has source-backed failures and partial fixes, but the permanent boundary affects session state, message delivery, task registry semantics, and ACP/native orchestration behavior.

options.title: Define Shared Yield-Wake Lifecycle
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for a unified parent wake/resume contract with regression coverage across ACP, native subagents, blocked delivery, and heartbeat-disabled cases.

options.title: Land Narrow Repairs Separately
options.body: Treat the open ACP and blocked-delivery PRs as independent patches and revisit the broader lifecycle model only if remaining repros persist.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Pause product-direction work until a maintainer or contributor proves the exact current-main failure path in a real channel/runtime setup.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Yield-Wake Lifecycle
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for a unified parent wake/resume contract with regression coverage across ACP, native subagents, blocked delivery, and heartbeat-disabled cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged mainline fix in the central subagent completion delivery path is from sallyom, making them the best available routing candidate from the inspected history.
